provider_receipt.summary: Review found named defects unsupported by the clean-tree-only verification: (1) src/lib.rs:56-89 MemoryStore::store serializes each MemoryRecord and immediately discards it, so scan_vault performs no persistent ingestion despite claiming Mnemosyne-backed persistent memory; (2) src/lib.rs:13-25 and 152-163 implement a legacy frontmatter schema incompatible with docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-94, including numeric confidence instead of low|medium|high and omission of authority, privacy, provenance, review, and supersession fields; (3) src/lib.rs:106-129 ingests every Markdown note without enforcing classification, authority, privacy, quarantine, conflict, or review rules required by the contract; (4) src/lib.rs:110-114 silently discards directory traversal errors, allowing incomplete scans to report success; (5) src/lib.rs:166-193 labels outbound wikilinks as backlinks and permits links containing ../ to resolve outside the vault boundary. The durable evidence proves only an unchanged tree and does not verify these governed behaviors, so completion cannot be approved.
